audit.whatIsWrong: Almost every ability in this matchup was attached to the wrong slot. 'Doom Gaze' (whys[4], spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.foe[2]) is not a Vex ability at all. The fear is credited to Personal Space in enemyWin, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and focus.text — Personal Space is a shield, and the fear is the passive Doom 'n Gloom. And the dash-punish is credited to Mistral Bolt in whys[3], spikes[0], early, late, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0] — the dash mark is also the passive, Mistral Bolt is just a missile.
audit.why: Riot: Doom 'n Gloom (P) — 'Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark…'. Mistral Bolt (Q) — 'Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight', 8/7/6/5/4s, 1200 range. Personal Space (W) — 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies', 16/15/14/13/12s, 475 range. Looming Darkness (E) — slow zone, 12s flat, 800. Shadow Surge (R) — mark then recast to dash, 140/120/100s, 2000/2500/3000.
audit.corrected: Every ability put back on its own slot, with the fear identified as the charged passive and the burst window identified as Shadow Surge. The range picture — 1200 / 800 / up to 3000 against your 750 beam — is now stated, because it is why she wins the early lane.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, cds and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer is written for the pre-rework Aurelion Sol and, worse, builds a false premise on it: 'your dash-reliant kit', 'your dash windows', 'Comet of Legend movement', 'Starsurge', 'stacked stars'. Aurelion Sol has no dash.
audit.why: The current kit is Breath of Light (750 beam), Astral Flight (a 1500-range flight over terrain, not a dash), the black hole, and Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Vex's anti-dash mark therefore does not have the free target this text assumes.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in current-kit terms throughout. Where the old text said Mistral Bolt punishes your dashes, the new text says what actually happens: she outranges you and the charged passive fears you out of the channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] read 'Aurelion Sol' — two chart rows rendering different answers per layer.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer (Vex x5, then Aurelion Sol x2), and both phases whys already argue that Aurelion Sol owns those stages.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side set to 'Aurelion Sol'. The whys already match the new verdict, so no rewrite was needed there. Rows 0-4 agree across both layers and were left alone; phases[4].why was rewritten because it argued for Aurelion Sol under a Vex row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet reports sequencingCues: 0 and 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' for an ability with no fixed timer.
audit.why: Defect catalogue items 3 and 6. Doom 'n Gloom has no listed cooldown at all — it charges over time and is accelerated when a nearby enemy dashes — so a number there would be fabricated. The numbers that do exist are Personal Space 16s to 12s, Looming Darkness 12s flat, Mistral Bolt 8s to 4s, Shadow Surge 140s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with the real numbers and an explicit 'no fixed timer, watch for the glow' for the passive. dosFull[2].d now describes the actual window (she spends the charge) instead of inventing fifteen seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vex is female but the whole full layer addresses her as 'he/his': tldr, report[0].t, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[9].t, report[11].t, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[1].t. notes:
WORST ABILITY-ATTRIBUTION DAMAGE IN MY SLICE. Three separate misattributions ran through this matchup: a wholly invented ability ('Doom Gaze'), the fear credited to Personal Space when it belongs to Doom 'n Gloom, and the anti-dash mark credited to Mistral Bolt when it also belongs to the passive. The packet's suspectNames was EMPTY for this matchup — the near-miss detector cannot catch a fabricated name that is not a near-miss of a real one, or a real name attached to the wrong slot. Worth knowing before trusting suspectNames as coverage.

LEFT ALONE, NEEDS A DECISION: focus.text still reads "Vex Personal Space (Fear)", and the same mislabel appears inside loading. focus.text is exactly 25 characters and a corrected version would be shorter than the applier's 25-character skip floor, so I did not risk a half-applied fix; loading is a composed string I did not want to rewrite wholesale. Both should be changed to name Doom 'n Gloom as the fear. See questionsForUser.

FALSE PREMISE REMOVED: the content layer repeatedly called Aurelion Sol 'dash-reliant' and told the reader to avoid dashing. He has no dash. Astral Flight is a flight over terrain.

KIT FLAG MISFIRE: ownerKit W (Astral Flight) carries terrain='creates terrain'. Riot says he flies OVER terrain. Present on all seven briefs in my slice.

UNVERIFIED / LEFT ALONE: whether Doom 'n Gloom's mark triggers on Astral Flight (Riot says the mark applies 'whenever a nearby enemy dashes', and flight is not a dash in the ownerKit), and whether the fear interrupts Astral Flight mid-flight. dontsFull[1].d asserts the flight-ending fear; that is Medium confidence and rests on the ownerKit's interruptible-channel flag plus the missing-interactions rule, not on Riot's text.
